description: Finish an iOS release after the build is uploaded. When a build has been uploaded to App Store Connect by any tool (fastlane, asc, Xcode, Xcode Cloud, CI) and the user wants it shipped: attach the build to the version, clear export compliance, run the readiness sweep, fix what blocks, and submit for review through MetaRun. Also the way back after App Review rejects a version: read the verdict, fix, resubmit. Trigger phrases: "ship it", "submit the build", "finish the release", "send 2.4 to review", "the build is up", "Apple rejected it", "resubmit".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
